findings.desc: packages/main/src/cli/help-renderer.ts:52 BRIEF_DESC_MAX=10 truncates every per-command description in brief help to 10 CHARACTERS (not words), producing useless fragments like "List Proo…", "Report ov…", "Advance a…", "Probe one…" for essentially all ~320 commands. Live repro: node bin/lattice.js help shows host_probe  Probe one… and host_status  Report ov… — indistinguishable, no actual information about what each command does. This directly violates the CHK-003 adversarial acceptance intent brief must not degrade agent decision-making for the help catalog: an agent cannot pick the right command from these fragments and must always fall back to --full, defeating the token-savings goal of the story. brief-output-smoke.ts:256-265 only asserts byte-budget and branding presence, never asserts description content is meaningful, so this shipped undetected. Likely a units bug (10 chars vs intended ~40-60 chars or 10 words) given the surrounding budget reasoning in the code comment. Severity high because it materially breaks CHK-003s stated purpose while still passing all recorded evidence.
findings.resolvedReason: Commit 8a1c4f033b: brief help now renders grouped command names ONLY — briefCommandDescription/BRIEF_DESC_MAX removed entirely, so no mid-word fragments can render. Output 7,787 bytes (was 11,619 with fragments); footer routes details to lattice <command> --help and help --full. brief-output-smoke now asserts no ellipsis fragments and that every help --full catalog name appears in brief (>100 commands live); docs/CLI.md and plan.md CHK-003 updated; CHK-003:happy:0 evidence re-recorded with the declared deviation (intent frozen post-PLAN).

findings.desc: packages/main/src/handlers/story-query.ts:654 (openBugStories filter) changes story_list dashboard-summary CONTENT, not just rendering verbosity: it adds a DISCARDED exclusion to the not-closed bug-story flag, present in BOTH brief and --full output. This is a genuine logic/behavior fix (re-applying a regression of commit 288d359377 fix: ignore discarded bug stories in story_list from Apr 2026, which had been lost from the codebase before this story started per git show ac83c67618^). The story background/plan.md frames this story as rendering-only output hygiene with gate/state-machine behavior changes explicitly out of scope, and this specific fix is not named in plan.md CHK-004 or the scope-contract scopeChangeReason. It is well-evidenced (CHK-005:edge:1 runs scripts/verify-story-list-bug-summary.mjs green) and appears correct/desirable, but it is an undeclared drive-by content change riding on a story whose stated boundary is rendering-only; the code comment mischaracterizes it as accommodating a pre-existing test rather than restoring lost behavior. Severity low/advisory: functionally correct and tested, but a precedent worth flagging for scope discipline.
findings.resolvedReason: Kept deliberately and now DECLARED: plan.md CHK-004 documents the bundled restoration of commit 288d359377 behavior (story_list _bugSummary 'Bug Story not closed' excludes terminal DISCARDED alongside DONE). It is a summary-content fix, not a rendering trim, required because scripts/verify-story-list-bug-summary.mjs — a must-pass consumer verifier bound to CHK-004/CHK-005 evidence — was already red on baseline HEAD due to that regression. Frozen --json field set unaffected.

findings.desc: CHK-004:edge:1 (should): host_list borderline case (15,899 bytes, confirmed live) has no verificationEvidence record bound to this intentRef and no explicit disposition in docs/CLI.md. The CHK-004:edge:0 sweep evidence note lists host_list in an inline audited-under-threshold list ("host_list 15,899"), but the intent explicitly requires the borderline case be EITHER brought under brief-by-default OR explicitly documented as acceptable — docs/CLI.md brief-outputs table omits host_list entirely (unlike story_get, which gets a dedicated audited-disposition paragraph). So the disposition exists only in an evidence-log free-text note, not in the doc surface the intent points to, and is not bound to CHK-004:edge:1.

CHK-001:edge:1 and CHK-003:edge:1 (both should-priority scaling boundaries) lack any verificationEvidence: milestone_status with >20 milestones, and help with >100 registered commands. brief-output-smoke.ts fixtures only build 3 milestones (msBrief asserts "3 total" at line 209) and the live help catalog already has ~320 commands (well over 100) but no test asserts the brief renderer stays one-line-per-milestone / grouped-and-readable at that scale without truncation loss of identifiers. No evidence record exists for either intentRef.

Two remaining should-priority intents have zero verificationEvidence records: CHK-003:edge:0 (help with empty/filtered command list should emit graceful empty message) and CHK-005:adversarial:1 (validate/checklist_get ignore LATTICE_BRIEF_OUTPUT and --brief gracefully with no crash). Manual spot-check during this review confirms both behaviors currently work correctly live (checklist_get with brief:true and LATTICE_BRIEF_OUTPUT=0 both return unaffected full output, exit 0, no crash) but no committed test or transcript record exists for either, so a future regression would go undetected. CHK-006:edge:1 (CLAUDE.md reflection) is not counted as a gap since its own intent text states docs/CLI.md alone suffices when CLAUDE.md snippet regeneration does not apply, which is the case here.
